[Council File 26-0456]
City Attorney report and draft Ordinance relative to adding Subdivision 10 to Subsection (a) of Section 10.5 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code to exempt the Library Department publishing agreements from City Council approval.

No

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 29, 2026)
